lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Do you know if he kept any of it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Brendan, it’s important, you’ve been honest so far, you need to be honest all the way through here, OK?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: I don’t know where they are.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: You don’t know where the underwear are? I mean, do you have it? If a you do, it’s OK. We understand that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Do you think he might have kept it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Why do you think that? (pause) Did he tell you that?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: You said that you had cut her throat. (Brendan nods “yes”) Here’s the thing Brendan, when you cut somebody’s throat, they bleed a lot, (Brendan nods “yes”) OK? Am I right?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: She bleed a lot, (Brendan nods “yes”) so I know you had blood on ya, it’s pretty much impossible not to. Did you have blood on you?
